name: Social Login (Naver/Kakao/Google/Facebook/GitHub)
description: Adds Naver, Kakao, Google, Facebook, and GitHub OAuth login/signup.

settings.page_description: Enter the app keys issued by the Naver/Kakao/Google/Meta/GitHub developer consoles and turn each provider on.
settings.notice: Register each provider's redirect URI in its developer console: {base_url}/api/plugins/glitter-social_totp_passkey/naver/callback, {base_url}/api/plugins/glitter-social_totp_passkey/kakao/callback, {base_url}/api/plugins/glitter-social_totp_passkey/google/callback, {base_url}/api/plugins/glitter-social_totp_passkey/facebook/callback, and {base_url}/api/plugins/glitter-social_totp_passkey/github/callback.
settings.guide_item_1: NAVER Developers: register an application, enable NAVER Login, and copy its Client ID and Client Secret.
settings.guide_item_2: Kakao Developers > My Application > Kakao Login: issue a REST API key (Client ID) and a Client Secret; Google Cloud Console > APIs & Services > Credentials: create an OAuth client ID; Meta for Developers: use the Facebook Login App ID and App Secret; GitHub Developer settings: create an OAuth App and use its Client ID and Client Secret.
settings.guide_item_3: Turn on a provider to display its button on the login and registration screens. Enter that provider's Client ID and Client Secret before starting OAuth; the button can remain visible with incomplete credentials, but OAuth will not start successfully.

naver_enabled.label: Enable Naver login
naver_enabled.hint: Show the Naver login button on the login screen.

naver_client_id.label: Naver Client ID
naver_client_id.hint: The Client ID issued by NAVER Developers.

naver_client_secret.label: Naver Client Secret
naver_client_secret.hint: The Client Secret issued by NAVER Developers.

kakao_enabled.label: Enable Kakao login
kakao_enabled.hint: Show the Kakao login button on the login screen.

kakao_client_id.label: Kakao REST API key
kakao_client_id.hint: The REST API key (app key) from the Kakao developer console.

kakao_client_secret.label: Kakao Client Secret
kakao_client_secret.hint: The Client Secret issued under Kakao Login > Security.

google_enabled.label: Enable Google login
google_enabled.hint: Show the Google login button on the login screen.

google_client_id.label: Google Client ID
google_client_id.hint: The OAuth client ID issued by Google Cloud Console.

google_client_secret.label: Google Client Secret
google_client_secret.hint: The client secret issued by Google Cloud Console.

facebook_enabled.label: Enable Facebook login
facebook_enabled.hint: Show the Facebook login button on the login screen.

facebook_client_id.label: Facebook App ID
facebook_client_id.hint: The App ID issued by Meta for Developers.

facebook_client_secret.label: Facebook App Secret
facebook_client_secret.hint: The App Secret issued by Meta for Developers.

github_enabled.label: Enable GitHub login
github_enabled.hint: Show the GitHub login button on the login screen.

github_client_id.label: GitHub Client ID
github_client_id.hint: The OAuth App Client ID issued in GitHub Developer settings.

github_client_secret.label: GitHub Client Secret
github_client_secret.hint: The OAuth App Client Secret issued in GitHub Developer settings.

settings.provider_order_hint: Drag or use the move buttons to change the display order on the login, registration, and social account management screens.
settings.passkey_section_hint: Passkeys require the configured site URL to use HTTPS. Disabling the master switch makes all passkey authentication endpoints fail closed.
settings.passkey_totp_substitution_enabled: Allow a passkey instead of TOTP after social login
settings.passkey_login_requires_totp: Require TOTP after independent passkey login

auto_linked.name: Social account auto-linked
auto_linked.description: Sent when a social login is auto-linked to an existing account
auto_linked.subject: [{app_name}] Your {provider_name} account was automatically linked
auto_linked.body:
Hi {name},

A {provider_name} account ({provider_email}) was automatically linked to your {app_name} account. If this wasn't you, change your password immediately and unlink it from your profile page.
